verdict.rationale: Anthropic provides official Messages/Skills API with `container` parameter, skill_id/version fields, upload/management via the Skills API, and documented request limits (up to 20 skills per request), letting developers build against a genuine official SDK/API surface rather than a reverse-engineered one. This is corroborated by first-party API docs plus an open cross-tool specification (agentskills.io). missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports specifically building against the Skills API (not just Claude Code usage), and no mention of language-specific SDK code samples (Python/TS) for the Skills API endpoints.
